column1: # Known slow calls: our per-call cost against Metal's, where it is over an order of magnitude.
# READ THIS BEFORE ADDING A ROW. A row here is not an accepted difference and it is not permission
# for anything. It is a call that costs an order of magnitude more than Metal's over the cases both
# legs did exactly, written down so the one call that holds an open bug visible does not make every
# run red and teach everyone to stop reading the report. Nothing here is resolved by being listed.
# The gate is held in BOTH directions (src/slow_calls.rs): a call over the margin that is not
# listed fails the run, and a listed call that has come back inside the band fails it too, saying
# the row looks fixed and must go. So a row cannot outlive the bug it stands for.
# There is a third state, and it fails nothing: a row the measurement cannot resolve, or a whole
# measurement whose own instrument says it was taken on a CPU the figures cannot be compared across,
# is WITHHELD. Withholding neither adds a row nor retires one, and the run says which rows and why.
# Before adding a row, LOCALISE IT: `conformance times --runs 8 --call <name>` prints the call case
# by case. A per-call total says that a call is expensive and never where, and the first row below
# was 105x over the whole set and 1.2x over the three cases that obviously make it.
# A ratio here is a measurement and it moves MORE THAN EITHER OF ITS HALVES, because the two halves
# move independently. Over the two whole-set passes this tree has recorded on this M3 Max -- the
# only pair of independent whole-set measurements that exists -- the 98 paired rows common to both
# moved a median 2.62x, 14.96x at the 90th percentile and 63.9x at worst. Restricted to the rows the
# measurement can resolve at all it is a median 1.87x and 6.92x at the 90th percentile, which is why
# the band is margin / 7.0 and not the margin / 2.5 that a measurement of Metal's own totals bought.
# WHAT THAT MEANS FOR A ROW. Six calls read far over the margin in one of those two passes and far
# under it in the other -- texture_accesses 19.3x and 102.4x, function_facts 89.5x and 40.6x,
# function_facts_from_descriptor 86.2x and 28.5x, mesh_pipeline_bindings 74.5x and 18.5x,
# compute_pipeline_with_stage_input 57.5x and 22.6x, compute_pipeline_bindings 7.5x and 21.7x.
# NONE OF THEM HAS A ROW HERE, deliberately. The earlier pass is not reproducible by the binary that
# produced it: re-run now over the same fifteen cases, that binary reads function_facts at 46.3x and
# 40.9x against the 89.5x it recorded, and its per-case figures agree with today's to within 5%. The
# cause is the CPU the measurement ran on, not the call -- one binary and one case set inside one
# minute read 38.8x at the ordinary scheduling class and 75.5x under a background one, while the
# one-minute load average held at 6.1. A figure nobody can reproduce is worse than no figure, so the
# gate now withholds a verdict instead of demanding a row (src/slow_calls.rs: the instrument's own
# cost is bracketed per leg and checked against what this chip's recordings carry, and a row the
# measurement cannot resolve above that instrument is held in neither direction).
# So a row here needs a LOCALISED finding, not a pooled ratio: the first row below is 105x pooled
# and 1.2x over the three cases that obviously make it, and 265x over the 16 that actually do.
# Fields, tab-separated:
#   call                the Side call
# A COLD MEASUREMENT IS REPORTED AND NEVER JUDGED, so no row here is measured with
# `--cold-shaders`. That switch gives every case a fresh device as well as a fresh shader cache,
# and only on our leg, so a cold reading over the margin does not say whether the cost is our
# compile or first use on a new device: measured on this M3 Max, `target` is 0.9x warm and 14.3x
# cold and compiles nothing at all. Nine calls were over the margin cold against four warm, and
# seven of the nine were one mechanism. src/slow_calls.rs refuses to judge a cold run.
#   measured            the ratio its measurement read, with an x
#   where the cost is   the family it is in, and what the figure splits into
#   waiting on          what Metal does, what we do instead, and where the fix belongs
replace_region
column3: all of it in the 16 xr-two-plane-samples cases: one replaceRegion each, Metal 4 us against our 1210 us, 92% of ours blocked; the other 86 cases that make the call are 1.3x together
column4: Metal's replaceRegion on a two-plane extended-range texture answers in 4 us; ours waits about 1.1 ms, so we stage the upload and wait on it where Metal writes through. The fix is in the runtime's texture upload path for two-plane extended-range formats, not in the suite

column1: render_pipeline
column3: 85 calls over the comparable set, Metal 5459 us against our 181742 us, of which 168004 us is our own CPU
column4: Pipeline creation is CPU work we do and Metal does differently; AGENTS.md gives pipeline-creation time its own ceiling rather than the device API's, so this row records the size of the gap and is NOT yet attributed. It is unaudited: the alone-versus-in-set contrast has not been run on it

column3: one call, Metal 291 us against our 4274 us, 3946 us of it our own CPU
column4: The same pipeline-creation path as render_pipeline plus reflection; listed separately because one call is too thin a measurement to fold into that row
